in_marathi.name: Gyatri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sacred Veda hymn
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gyatri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gyatri comes from the sacred Vedic hymns called the Gyatri Mantra. This mantra is chanted daily by millions of Hindus and holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism.

in_bengali.name: Gyatri
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sacred Veda hymn
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gyatri একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Gyatri comes from the sacred Vedic hymns called the Gyatri Mantra. This mantra is chanted daily by millions of Hindus and holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism.
